assessment.model_case: The projected mean is about 1.25 shots with a median of one, so the under needs zero or one shot. The case rests on 15.5 projected minutes and a shrunk shot rate. If Kartye is moved up the lineup, that rate understates his volume.
assessment.price_case: Only the main 1.5 line is quoted, at +140 (break-even about 0.417). The model's fair price is near -185. Two other books exist, so this is not broad consensus, but the market leans clearly toward the over.
assessment.context_case: The injury table shows several Rangers forwards out, which could open top-six or power-play minutes. That would cut against the under. No Kartye-specific role report was supplied.
blocking_checks: Confirm Kartye's even-strength line and power-play unit. A top-six or PP1 role could explain the market's over lean and erase the under case.
